verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents its own vendor-payment and bill-pay capability: bulk payments to vendors in 150+ countries without wire fees, scheduled or same-day payments, and an MCP tool for managing vendors and their payment details. However, the evidence frames these as global or cross-border payments and never names domestic ACH or domestic wire rails, so the story's specific rails are only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of domestic ACH transfers, explicit documentation of domestic wire transfers, any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can send domestic ACH and wire payments to vendors

citations.quote: Pay vendors, employees, and contractors in bulk across 150+ countries & 40+ currencies without transfer fees or wire fees.
Send the payment now or schedule for a future date. Payments arrive as soon as the same day.
Pay vendors and handle bills — review bill pay invoices, manage vendors and their payment details
Manage cash in multiple currencies, issue cards, pay bills, and earn up to 5% annually
